description: Edge cases for DetectCross: (1) parallel lines that never cross — fast always below slow, returns empty event list; (2) equal-then-cross scenario where both series are equal for several bars then fast breaks above (bullish cross at the first bar where fast strictly exceeds slow); (3) minimum valid 2-element input with a cross.

cases.name: parallel-lines-no-cross
cases.description: fast always below slow — no crossover events expected

cases.name: equal-then-bullish-cross
cases.description: both lines equal for first 3 bars, then fast breaks above slow at index 3

cases.name: minimum-2-element-bullish
cases.description: minimum valid input: 2 bars, fast crosses above slow at index 1
